name: Brick
overview: Scripture highlights the use of bricks as a fundamental building material in ancient times, notably in the construction of the Tower of Babel, Egyptian cities, houses, and altars. The Israelites, under harsh bondage in Egypt, were forced to make bricks without straw, intensifying their labor and suffering. This demonstrates both the practical role of bricks in ancient construction and the oppressive conditions experienced by God's people, emphasizing God's faithfulness amid hardship.
